item.summary: fix(agents): run code-mode exec when a model sends a blank code alias (#126599) Treat blank code and command aliases as absent while preserving mismatch rejection when both aliases contain different instructions. Keep trusted hook and policy rewrites normalized at the Code Mode owner boundary. Co-authored-by: Marvinthebored Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
